summary: Restarting monitoring now syncs only new or changed files instead of re-queuing every existing file.
New and changed files start syncing during the startup check, and changes made as monitoring starts are picked up.
The startup check keeps an existing queued retry on its current schedule and preserves protected activation, Google credentials, mappings, and established sync behavior.
